title: Macro StoryLine — Growth, Inflation, Labor & Market Response
summary: A four-panel narrative capturing the evolving macro landscape across growth, inflation, labor conditions, and market reaction into year-end.

rows.title: Growth & Inflation — Manufacturing Softens While Dollar Pass-Through Builds
rows.story: ISM manufacturing remains weak while order flow and employment soften further. At the same time, a softer USD begins lifting import prices, signaling early-stage inflation stabilization. Together, these shifts portray a late-cycle mix of cooling momentum and rising sensitivity to currency-driven price pressures.

rows.title: Labor & Market Reaction — Hiring Slows, Gold Breaks Higher
rows.story: Private hiring momentum deteriorated as ADP registered a sharp decline, reinforcing signs of economic cooling. Market pricing continues to anticipate policy easing while the weaker USD amplifies flows into precious metals. Gold’s breakout reflects this macro hedge dynamic and aligns with expectations of softer labor and slower growth.
